issue.title: Auto-rebuild docs when a mounted local sphinx_airflow_theme changes
issue.body:
### Description

#75001 adds `breeze build-docs --sphinx-airflow-theme-path`, which builds the docs once with the
`sphinx_airflow_theme` folder of a local `airflow-site` checkout. Review of the earlier attempt (#70139)
also asked for a watch mode:

- run the docs build with its existing auto-rebuild option, and
- rebuild the mounted theme automatically when its files change in the mounted folder, so that
  editing the theme refreshes the built docs without re-running Breeze.

That part is not in #75001. This issue tracks it.

### Use case/motivation

Iterating on theme CSS, JS or templates currently needs `./site.sh prepare-theme` in `airflow-site` and a full
`breeze build-docs` run for every change.

### Related issues

#45576, #70139, #75001

---
Drafted-by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5); reviewed by @shahar1 before posting
